query: I went to the new coffee shop downtown this morning, and their lavender oat milk latte was perfectly sweet and even had a little heart foam art on top. I stopped by the pet store on my way home too, and the golden retriever puppies there were so playful, one of them kept nibbling my shoelace when I knelt down to say hi. I also just finished rearranging my bookshelf by genre, all the fantasy novels are now on the top shelf next to my little succulent collection. My phone isn't connecting to any calls or mobile data right now, I double checked and airplane mode is switched on, and my SIM card is locked with a PIN so I can't access the network settings to fix it.
